entries.title: Each task can use a browser of its own
entries.body: A crewmate can now open a website, or a page your project shows on this Mac, in its task's own browser: it reads the page, fills it in, clicks through it and takes pictures of it. Open the Browser line on the task to watch it work. When a page needs you, such as a sign-in, take control, then hand it back. A crewmate never pays or sends a final form itself: it stops on a review card and you finish on the page. You can remember a website's sign-in on this Mac, and a later task uses it only after you allow it on that task's card. Settings lists the sign-ins you saved, each with Remove.

picture.alt: A task's own browser on the stage, showing a cafe's Book a table page while its crewmate fills it in
